novelty_flags.label: thm:graphwise-sid-completeness
novelty_flags.one_line: The stated Ident_S class restricts models to independent edge-latents, whereas AboueiEtAl2024LatentSID defines S-ID over augmented SCMs whose independent exogenous variables may be shared across several endogenous mechanisms; the theorem therefore does not yet settle the published conjecture on its stated class.

soundness_flags.label: def:eq23-functional and thm:graphwise-sid-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: Phi_23 is declared as a map of P^S alone but is asserted equal to Theta_x for every intervention value x; define an x-indexed functional and make the x_N and x_S evaluations of all selected kernels explicit.

soundness_flags.label: G / ass:semimarkovian-compatibility / thm:graphwise-sid-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem quantifies over arbitrary augmented ADMGs, but the cited latent S-ID setup requires S to have no children; impose that sink condition or state a new algorithm and soundness argument for graphs with outgoing edges from S.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7-8, Theorem 5.1 and Algorithm 1; p. 10, Conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5.1 supplies a sufficient no-S-Hedge condition, Algorithm 1 returns an expression or FAIL, and the conclusion says the method is sound while completeness is conjectured.

The paper defines an augmented SCM with mutually independent exogenous variables that can be shared by endogenous mechanisms, requires S to have no children, and defines S-ID over SCMs having the augmented causal graph.
The fully observed S-ID criterion is necessary and sufficient, and its necessity proof constructs same-selected-law separating SEMs.

Replace Phi_23(P^S) everywhere by Phi_23,x(P^S), with explicit treatment-value evaluation for the outer conditional and each recursive selected kernel.
